claims.claim: Sample rate is nominally 26.04 kHz for record and playback
claims.evidence_source: SRC-05; ~26 kHz tone measured on SP-12, SRC-04

claims.claim: Rate derives from 20 MHz ÷ 3 ÷ 256 = 26 041.67 Hz
Data format is 12-bit linear
Conversion is successive approximation using SAR logic, a comparator and the playback DAC, after a sample-and-hold
claims.implementation_impact: No separate ADC model; ADC and DAC share one transfer

claims.claim: The DAC is an AD7541 12-bit multiplying DAC
One DAC is time-multiplexed to 8 channels, each with its own hold
Per-voice level is set by an 8-bit multiplying DAC referenced to the 12-bit DAC output
claims.implementation_impact: No digital gain block; unity point unknown

claims.claim: AA filter is a fixed multi-section active low-pass on TL084 op-amps; on the SP-12 it attenuates above ~15 kHz
On the SP-12, aliasing from input sampling is a minor contributor; output imaging and tuning dominate
Pitch change is by dropping/repeating samples with a truncated fractional index at fixed output rate
claims.implementation_impact: Unity is identity; tuned mode is a separate block

claims.claim: Tuning is in semitone steps
Channels 7–8 have no filter; hold images appear above 13 kHz
claims.evidence_source: SRC-03, -05; measured on SP-12 in SRC-04

claims.claim: Channels 1–2 use SSM2044 4-pole filters whose cutoff is swept by an envelope started at trigger, fixed Q
Channels 3–4 have a fixed low-pass at a lower corner than channels 5–6
claims.implementation_impact: Two selectable filter blocks; values unknown

claims.claim: MIX OUT is a mono mix of the eight channel outputs with a volume control
Unfiltered versions of channel outputs are available at the individual jacks on an alternate contact
claims.implementation_impact: Direct measurement of each filter by ratio

claims.claim: Sampling is mono through a single input
claims.implementation_impact: SP stage has no historical stereo

claims.claim: Input gain is selectable 0 / +20 / +40 dB
An ideal 12-bit quantizer has 74.0 dB SQNR; LSB is −72.2 dB re FS
An ideal full-period hold at 26 041.67 Hz has −0.53 / −2.22 / −3.92 dB at 5 / 10 / 13.02 kHz
claims.implementation_impact: Expected droop if hold is full-period

claims.claim: Input and output filters use TL084 op-amps
2.5 s per sound, 10 s total
Nominal levels, impedances, rails and clip points
Presence of dither, rounding rule, encoding
1993 reissue changed power supply and chassis; SSM2044 used until 1998; 2021 Rossum reissue keeps the format, substitutes SSI2144, adds input monitor and separate filtered/unfiltered jacks
Static DAC nonlinearity largely cancels between record and playback because one DAC serves both
44.1 kHz sampling; stated response 20 Hz – 20 kHz
Storage is 16-bit linear
AK5328-VP, 18-bit stereo delta-sigma with 64 fs oversampling digital filter
SM5841HP 8× digital filter feeding PCM69AP 18-bit dual DAC
Four SM5841HP + four PCM69AP, NJM5532D I/V, M5220L filter/buffer, to eight 2-pole jacks
PCM69A → NJM5532D → M5220L low-pass/buffers → relay → stereo out; M5216L for phones
3-pole jacks, 45 kΩ; sensitivity −58 / −38 / −18 dBs; 3-position switch; dual 10 kΩ record-level pot; M5238AL, M5220L, µPC812C
Regulated ±12 V; local 5 V regulators and LDOs at converters
33.8688 MHz crystal = 768 × 44.1 kHz; synchronous
Akai L7A1045 L6028 "18 bit digital signal processor" with serial 18-bit DAC data and separate word clocks per output pair
Per-voice 12 dB/oct resonant low-pass is digital
claims.evidence_source: SRC-20 spec; no analog VCF parts
claims.implementation_impact: Not in mix path at unity

claims.claim: True phase-locked stereo sampling
S/PDIF input via YM3623B, 44.1 kHz only
Stereo and individual output level printed as "6 dBm / 600 ohms"
PCM69A: 10-bit DAC + 1-bit first-order noise-shaped DAC, single +5 V, 0–1.2 mA, 1.8 kΩ, DR 106 dB, max THD+N −92 dB, SNR 110 dB
claims.implementation_impact: DAC not the limiting element on paper

claims.claim: Method of 18 → 16-bit reduction
Mixer word length, gain/pan arithmetic, interpolation
Input and output filter orders and corners
claims.evidence_source: Values present in SRC-20 scan; not extracted

claims.claim: De-emphasis control lines are wired to the SM5841s
claims.implementation_impact: Must confirm inactive in normal playback

claims.claim: The MPC3000 path audibly colors undriven line-level program
claims.implementation_impact: Decides whether the MPC stage is more than linear + quantizer

claims.claim: SP output level is undocumented in retrieved sources; MPC sensitivity is documented
claims.status: VERIFIED (as a statement about the evidence)

claims.claim: A line-level SP output can overdrive the MPC input depending on record level
SP hold images between 13 and 20 kHz lie inside the MPC passband and would be recorded
claims.implementation_impact: Internal analog-proxy rate must carry images

claims.claim: SP stage has no historical stereo path; MPC stage does
claims.implementation_impact: Stereo SP is a product abstraction

claims.claim: Cascade baseband is set by the SP stage
The full path cannot be zero latency; magnitude unknown
claims.evidence_source: Architecture (analog filters, FIR converter filters, resamplers)

claims.claim: Resampling SP-1200 output into an MPC3000 was a common production practice
claims.implementation_impact: No authenticity claim may rest on it
